description:
Sportsbrut , or Corporate Neu-Grunge , Sports Brutalism is a graphic design aesthetic that gained prevalence in the mid-late 2010s, diffusing the high-octane athletic branding with unpolished traits of Neubrutalism , which utilizes aggressive, industrial textures and bold layouts to convey speed, action, and raw kinetic energy.

The aesthetic style leans on a unique middle ground where it is often more maximalist and less glossy than corporate, standard Y2K neu-grunge, but dynamic and slightly more textured than sterile, bold digital neubrutalism.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Action, excitement, energy
